name: Capability Grant Model
description: Define how capabilities are granted, scoped, delegated, and revoked. Capability algebra: compose, restrict, attenuate.
acceptanceCriteria: Capability is a first-class type with scope, rights, and source.
Capability algebra supports compose (AND), restrict (intersect), and attenuate (narrow).
Capability grant produces a cryptographically signed grant record.
Delegation preserves provenance through the delegation chain.
Revocation invalidates all derived capabilities transitively.
